body.content: Plain-language health proposal reference (team17 only; based on the team17 dossier). The public health proposal lists four figures: 23, 26, 31, and 50. It attributes them to a local synthetic municipal ledger. The source does not specify what each figure measures, its units, collection method, or time period. Therefore their meaning and comparability cannot be established, and they should not be interpreted as clinical outcomes or evidence of treatment effectiveness. This summarizes a local proposal; it is not medical advice or external clinical guidance. This analysis is for team17 only and is not approved for public distribution. Provenance: health-public revision 1 and health-team17 revision 3; plain-language translation at revision 2.
